out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Facility was using chlorine as a sanitizer. A chlorine test kit was not observed on site
violations.corrective_action: PIC ORDERED A CHLORINE TEST KIT DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: The backflow prevention device (atmospheric breaker) on the mop sick was observed without a top.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE LANDLORD INSTALL A NEW BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs being stored over Ready-to-eat food.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer container of mozzarella cheese was observed reused for the storage of oil.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. USE REFILLABLE FOOD STORAGE CONTAINERS TO STORE OIL.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Two counter top coffee machines were observed without a backflow prevention device.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE A PLUMBER INSTALL A BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE WATERLINES OF THE TWO COFFEE MACHINES. PIC TOOK PICTURE OF THE APPROPRIATE BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. PIC CALLED A MAINTENANCE MAN TO INSTALL A BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a chlorine/bleach test kit for use with bleach+water sanitizer. An ammonia (QT-40) Test kit may be used with ammonia based sanitizers like Steramine(tablets). EHS provided a few test strips for temporary testing. PIC stated they would obtain additional test strips and maybe acquire sanitizing tablets for use in the facility.
